title: Signal embedded Cantrip workbench readiness
reason: An iframe load event also fires for proxy and browser error documents, while the remote extension host cannot access the iframe DOM. The embedding client needs a browser-context signal that is emitted only by the real OpenVSCode workbench after its editor part has mounted and layout restore has completed. A per-mount nonce lets the client bind the signal to the exact iframe without exposing attachment credentials.
validation: Mount Cantrip Code with a valid cantripFrameNonce query parameter and confirm the parent receives cantrip-code.workbench-ready only after the editor part is restored
removal: Remove when OpenVSCode exposes an embedder readiness API that distinguishes the rendered workbench from an iframe error document and supports per-mount correlation.
